limits: The eight-run interleaved benchmark covers actual installed offline Lake preparation and complete compiled-input bytes. It is not a browser, physical-paint, cold-install, inference or evidence-admission benchmark.
First semantic preparation and restarted-host cached opening are single unpaired functional measurements. Do not interpret their difference or a preceding deployment sample as a controlled speedup.
Raw complete graphs, source/readers/inventory/history/evidence and public choices are preserved. New graph/publication and compiler/search object identities reflect actual resource changes.

The short O_PATH metadata handle is closed before the original later content read. Filesystem concurrency, namespace/name attribution and actual I/O remain adapters, not new Lean or pinned-snapshot proofs.

Current cache-hit traces have no graph-extraction/search/render adapter calls, but Lake dependency preparation can still run compilation as needed. Nested spans are not additive and host-thread CPU excludes children.

Broad shared resource fingerprints also invalidate the unchanged frozen/search paths when this prepared-input helper changes. Transitive resource partitioning, prepared-snapshot reuse, remaining session/snapshot typing and the complete retirement audit remain open.

Public journeys use actual installed Lean/Lake/Z3 and scripted inference. They do not establish paid-model quality, cold verifier installation, 100–600B local operation, whole-renderer authenticity or complete R1.
